title: When the Parish Falls
author: U. M. Underhill
blurb: Ivo Fairweather, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
